title: Vote on which of Hacker News' challenges for AI have been met
summary: A community-driven voting tool that allows people to evaluate whether specific AI challenges and goals previously proposed on Hacker News have actually been met by current AI systems. The tool provides a way to track AI progress against historical predictions.
problem_solved: Tracks whether AI has fulfilled the challenges and predictions set by the Hacker News community over time.
why_valuable: Provides historical accountability for AI predictions, helping the community understand whether AI hype matches actual progress.
